lines.zh: 我绕过菌柄，斧头一直朝着你。
lines.en: I round a mushroom stalk, axe still pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你没拿旗帜，那就别怪我。
lines.en: You carry no banner, so do not blame me.

lines.zh: 斧头拖在地上，划出一道沟。
lines.en: My axe drags along the ground, cutting a furrow.

lines.zh: 踩着蘑菇柄，一步步往前走。
lines.en: I walk on mushroom stems, step by step.

lines.zh: 举着邪教徒旗，我就放你一马。
lines.en: Raise the cult banner and I spare you.

lines.zh: 我把一枚菌盖摆正，像摆祭品。
lines.en: I straighten a mushroom cap as if setting an offering.

lines.zh: 旗杆插在土里，我守着它。
lines.en: The banner pole is set in the soil, and I guard it.

lines.zh: 我对着蘑菇丛低声念词。
lines.en: I mutter words at the mushroom grove.

lines.zh: 真菌平原的风，把孢子吹我一脸。
lines.en: The fungal plains blow spores into my face.
I sharpen the axe and wait.

lines.zh: 我数着菌盖，等蘑菇王开口。
lines.en: I count mushroom caps, waiting for the King to speak.

lines.zh: 祭品还差一个，我看了看你。
lines.en: The offering is one short. I glance at you.

lines.zh: 我跪了一会儿，又站起来。
lines.en: I kneel for a while, then stand again.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙缝里还卡着上一顿。
lines.en: My tusks still hold scraps of the last meal.

lines.zh: 我把斧头换到左手，你该懂了。
lines.en: I shift my axe to my left hand; you should understand.

lines.zh: 我数你腰间挂了几块铁。
lines.en: I count the iron pieces hung at your waist.

lines.zh: 我的斧刃映着菌光，正对着你。
lines.en: My axe blade catches the fungal glow, aimed at you.
The Mushroom King above, me below.

lines.zh: 你手里没有旗，那就别靠近。
lines.en: You carry no banner, so keep your distance.
Stays on alert for the player.
Stares at the player, looking for an opening.
Keeps a close eye on the player.

lines.zh: 你的护甲有一道旧缝，我看见了。
lines.en: There is an old seam in your armor — I see it.

lines.zh: 我举起旗子，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I raise the banner, then slowly lower it.

lines.zh: 你手里没旗，那就没得谈。
lines.en: You carry no banner, so there is nothing to discuss.

lines.zh: 你散发出诱人的光芒，邪教徒们开始躁动！
lines.en: You emit a tempting glow, and the cultists grow restless.

lines.zh: 别靠近，这蘑菇王的信徒！
lines.en: Stay back, servant of the Mushroom King.

lines.zh: 我们以生命之火为祭品，让蘑菇王满意！
lines.en: We sacrifice life's fire to please the Mushroom King.

lines.zh: 这旗帜能保护你免受攻击！
lines.en: This banner protects you from attacks.

lines.zh: 我们是真菌之灵的祭司，你不能靠近！
lines.en: We are priests of the fungal spirit; you cannot approach.

lines.zh: 快放下武器，我们会慈悲地收留你！
lines.en: Drop your weapon, and we may spare you.

lines.zh: 邪教徒斧，赐予我们力量！
lines.en: The Cultist Axe, it gives us strength.

lines.zh: 你的气味吸引来了更多的邪教徒！
蘑菇王的信徒，永生不灭！
lines.en: Servants of the Mushroom King, forever unending.

lines.zh: 别试图反抗，这是你的命运！
lines.en: Do not resist, it is your destiny.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声惊扰了我们！

lines.en: Stay away from that light; it is dangerous.
Cultist, cleave him with the axe!

lines.zh: 快闪开，别被它的力量震倒！
lines.en: Step aside, do not be struck by its power.

lines.zh: 邪教徒斧，劈碎他的盾牌！

lines.en: Use the Cultist Axe to counterattack!

lines.zh: 选择一个伴侣，加入我们的行列！
lines.en: Choose a mate and join our ranks!

lines.zh: 她是我们的新娘，必须保护她！
lines.en: She is our bride; protect her!

lines.zh: 用邪教徒斧保卫你的伴侣！
lines.en: Defend your companion with the Cultist Axe!

lines.zh: 邪教徒们，为我们的未来战斗！
你的伴侣是我们的姐妹！
邪教徒斧，赐予我们勇气！

lines.en: Cultist, swear to the Mushroom King!

lines.zh: 我们共同守护这片土地！
邪教徒们，让爱燃烧起来！
手持邪教徒旗帜，你变得免疫了。
lines.en: Hold the Cultist Banner, and you're immune.

lines.zh: 真菌的礼物，不是用来吃的。
这棵树，是我们的守护神。
蘑菇王的意志，无人违抗。
你踩碎了一枚菌盖，蘑菇王听见了。
lines.en: You crushed a mushroom cap; the Mushroom King heard it.

lines.zh: 蘑菇王的眼睛，看透一切。
你把命献给蘑菇王了吗？
lines.en: Have you given your life to the Mushroom King?
Your death, for the Mushroom King.

lines.zh: 你摘了那面旗，现在归我管。
lines.en: You picked that banner; now you answer to me.

lines.zh: 祭品的数目，正好凑齐了。
lines.en: The count of offerings is finally complete.

lines.zh: 灵魂归位，永世不得超生。
你的血肉将滋养蘑菇王！
lines.en: Your flesh feeds the Mushroom King!
Axe of the cult cuts you!
Raise the flag to be safe!

lines.zh: 菌盖掀开，我从孢子雾里走出来。
lines.en: A mushroom cap lifts, and I walk out of the spore mist.

lines.zh: 三把斧头一起来，为一个王。
lines.en: Three axes come at once, for one King.

lines.zh: 真菌平原太滑，我摔了一跤。
lines.en: The fungal plain is slick. I fell.
